title: Will Pat Bryant win the Broncos WR3 competition?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Will Pat Bryant win the Broncos WR3 competition?
sources.description: With their 74th overall selection in the third round of the 2025 NFL Draft, the Denver Broncos selected Illinois wide receiver Pat Bryant. He is a big and physical wide receiver known for his blocking skills and fits the play style and skill set that head coach Sean Payton looks for in his wide receivers. […]
